name: Hangzhou Jiuyuan Genetic Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Jiuyuan Genetic Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd., incorporated in 1993 and headquartered in Hangzhou, researches, develops, makes and sells biopharmaceutical products and medical devices in mainland China and abroad. Products include the Guyoudao bone repair material and injectables such as Jilifen, Jijufen and Jixinfen, along with Jilixin tablets and low molecular weight heparins. It was formerly Hangzhou Jiuyuan Gene Engineering Co., Ltd., renamed in April 2025.
